## Why visit

Known locally as the Thumb, this is an appealing excursion for visitors who value a pub’s social life as much as its list of beers. Local people rescued and reopened it, and the reward is a small, welcoming place with a focused cask selection and active community use. It offers a different experience from Manchester’s grand interiors and brewery taprooms. Make it the reason for a Marple Bridge outing, perhaps with a daylight village walk, rather than trying to squeeze it into the central Stockport circuit. CAMRA’s 2026 regional recognition reinforces its detour value.

## Beer

CAMRA describes two or three well-kept changing beers, often including mild or another dark style.
